fsid.description: The cluster filesystem ID (UUID). Required. Example: '5d42928f-b53a-4f3e-8c7a-1f4e8e9f6b2a'.

mon_initial_members.description: List of initial monitor hostnames for bootstrap.

mon_host.description: List of monitor IP addresses or hostnames (must match mon_initial_members or be resolvable).

public_network.description: CIDR notation of the public (client) network.

cluster_network.description: CIDR notation of the cluster (replication) network.

auth_cluster_required.description: Authentication required for cluster daemons (e.g., mon->mon, osd->osd). Usually 'cephx'.

auth_service_required.description: Authentication required for services (e.g., MDS, RGW). Usually 'cephx'.

log_to_stderr.description: Whether to log to standard error (console). Enable for containerized or systemd-managed setups.

log_to_syslog.description: Whether to send logs to syslog. Useful for central log aggregation.

osd_op_threads.description: Number of threads per OSD for handling client operations. Higher values may improve throughput on multi-core systems.

osd_max_object_name_len.description: Maximum length of an object name (bytes).

osd_max_object_namespace_len.description: Maximum length of an object namespace (bytes).

mds_max_mds.description: Maximum number of active MDS daemons in the CephFS metadata pool. Set >1 for HA.

rbd_default_format.description: Default RBD image format (1 = legacy, 2 = modern, with layered cloning and features). Format 2 is strongly recommended.

rgw_frontends.description: List of frontends for RADOS Gateway (RGW). Each entry configures the HTTP server (e.g., 'civetweb port=80', 'nginx port=443 ssl_certificate=...').

monitors.description: Monitor-specific overrides. Optional — Ceph auto-generates these if not specified.

host.description: Hostname or FQDN of the monitor node.

addr.description: Monitor public address in the form 'ip:port' (e.g., '10.0.0.10:6789').

osds.description: OSD-specific configuration. Required only when overriding defaults (e.g., dedicated journal devices).

journal_dev.description: Dedicated journal device (e.g., '/dev/nvme0n1p1'). Optional (not needed with filestore+journal file, deprecated for bluestore).

journal_size.description: Journal size in MiB (e.g., 5120). Only used with journal_dev.

pools.description: List of pools with their settings. Default includes RBD and internal .mgr pool.

pg_num.description: Number of placement groups (PGs). Must be a power of two or set automatically later.

pgp_num.description: Number of PGs for placement purposes (usually equals pg_num).

size.description: Number of replicas per object (e.g., 2, 3). Must be ≥ min_size.

min_size.description: Minimum number of replicas required to serve I/O.

crush_rule.description: Name of CRUSH rule to use (optional, defaults to replicated_rule).

enable_ec.description: Set to true to use erasure coding instead of replication.

ec_profile.description: Name of erasure code profile to use (required if enable_ec=true).

application.description: Application marker (e.g., 'rbd', 'rgw', 'cephfs') to enable client integration.

ec_profiles.description: Erasure code profiles for pools using erasure coding.

crush_locality.description: CRUSH rule to constrain data chunks (e.g., 'host').

rgw_instances.description: RGW instance configurations for object storage.
